title: Mysterious Library Chamber
description: A person sees a large open book with spiral patterns resting on a gnarled tree root desk in an old stone room filled with tall bookshelves and lit candles. Two hooded figures sit at a broken window looking at each other with their hands touching an open book between them while a hanging lantern glows above and scattered papers lie on the floor.
